description.value: Woody's Pub is a cozy, long-established neighborhood pub on Highway 97 in Lake Country (Winfield), part of the Woodsman Group's family of Okanagan pubs. Known for hearty pub classics like beef dip, steak dinners, and Sunday roast, it draws a loyal local following and welcomes visitors with a warm, laid-back atmosphere. The pub regularly hosts live music nights and comedy events, making it a lively stop along the Okanagan corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at woodsmangroup.com/woodys-pub/ confirms an active, open pub at 9882 BC-97, Lake Country, BC with phone 250.766.2310, corroborating the OSM URL. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all amenity fields default to null per the absence-of-evidence rule. The business is clearly operational based on active social media posts, event listings, and recent customer reviews.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone number; both were sourced from the website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible pub with an active website, recent social posts, and confirmed address on Highway 97 in Lake Country.
